Issue operations (search, get, create, update, delete, etc.)

Usage: atlassian-cli jira issue [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  search      Search issues using JQL or filter parameters
  get         Fetch a single issue
  create      Create a new issue
  update      Update an existing issue
  delete      Delete an issue
  transition  Transition an issue to a new status
  assign      Assign issue to user
  unassign    Unassign issue
  watchers    Manage issue watchers
  links       Manage issue links
  comments    Manage issue comments
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -f, --format <FORMAT>  Output format for command results (table, json, yaml, csv, quiet, markdown)
                         [default: table] [possible values: table, json, yaml, csv, quiet, markdown]
      --envelope         Wrap JSON/YAML list output in {"data": [...], "count": N} envelope
  -h, --help             Print help
